speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history; the combination of a non-healing penile lesion and a similar lesion on your finger, especially given your age and smoking history, raises concern for malignancy. Have you noticed any ulceration, induration, or raised borders on either lesion, and do they have a distinct color like black, blue, or red-black? REQUEST TEST: Full body skin exam with dermoscopy of both lesions.
